# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ML PIPELINE — PRIMARY ANALYSIS
# Outcomes: TSH_OOR_1, TSH_high, TSH_low
# Datasets: ds.full, ds.reduced
# Models:   Elastic Net, Random Forest, XGBoost
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r libraries}
# Core
library(tidyverse)     # dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, readr, stringr, purrr, ...
library(caret)         # model training / CV
library(glmnet)        # elastic net
library(ranger)        # random forest
library(xgboost)       # gradient boosting
library(pROC)          # ROC, AUC, DeLong tests

# Interpretability
library(shapviz)
library(kernelshap)

# Output / figures
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)

# ── Parallelization ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(parallelly)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)    # caret CV-fold parallelization
library(future)        # kernelshap parallelization (NOT doParallel)

N_WORKERS <- max(1L, parallelly::availableCores() - 1L)

# FORK is unavailable on Windows; use PSOCK there
cluster_type <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "PSOCK" else "FORK"
cl <- makeCluster(N_WORKERS, type = cluster_type)
registerDoParallel(cl)

plan(multisession, workers = N_WORKERS)

cat(sprintf("Parallel workers registered: %d (doParallel, %s)\n",
            foreach::getDoParWorkers(), cluster_type))
cat(sprintf("Future workers registered:   %d (kernelshap)\n",
            future::nbrOfWorkers()))
```

```{r load-data, eval=TRUE}
# NOTE: ds.full.csv and ds.reduced.csv are NOT included in this repository

  ds.full    <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "ds.full.csv"))
  ds.reduced <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "ds.reduced.csv"))

} else {

      "this public repository.\nRendering code only.\n")
}

```{r configuration}
# ── 0. Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

OUTCOMES <- c("TSH_OOR_1", "TSH_high", "TSH_low")

DATASETS <- list(
  full    = ds.full,
  reduced = ds.reduced
)

# All outcome columns — used to exclude non-target outcomes from feature sets
ALL_OUTCOME_COLS <- c(
  "TSH_OOR_1", "TSH_OOR_2",
  "TSH_high",  "TSH_10",
  "TSH_low",   "TSH_0.1",
  "TSH_value"
)

# Columns to always exclude from features
BASE_EXCLUDE <- c(
  "patientid", "index_date", "age_cat", "ZIP",
  "levo_dose_cat", "gap", "n_comorbidities", "n_medications",
  "comorbid_cat", "med_cat"
)

# Required levels (in order) of the ordered factor gap_cat
GAP_CAT_LEVELS <- c("42-90 days", "91-180 days", "181-270 days", "271-365 days")

# Ordered categoricals — preserved as integer ordinals for SHAP encoding
# Using intersect() at point of use handles columns absent from a given dataset
ORDERED_COLS <- c("levo_dose_cat", "gap_cat", "med_cat")

# Nominal categoricals — dummy-expanded for SHAP, restored in pred_fun
NOMINAL_COLS <- c("PAT_SEX", "PAT_RACE", "ETHNIC", "year")

N_SHAP_FEATURES <- 15    # top N features in SHAP plots
SEED            <- 42    # (SHAP_BG_SIZE is set below by DEV_MODE)

# ── Conditional class weighting threshold ─────────────────────────────────────
# Every model type (elastic net, random forest, XGBoost) applies inverse-
# frequency class weighting (via get_class_weights()) IF AND ONLY IF an
# outcome's event rate (computed
# fresh from that iteration's own training split, every time this pipeline
# runs) falls below this threshold. This is evaluated per outcome x dataset x
# stratum combination -- NOTHING in this pipeline hardcodes which outcome
# triggers it. In this study's data, only the TSH <0.1 mIU/L outcome happens
# to fall below 5% event rate (confirmed by checking event rate across every
# outcome x dataset x stratum combination -- see manuscript Methods);
# on a different population, a different outcome (or none, or several) could
# trigger this instead, and the pipeline will detect and handle that
# automatically without any code changes. The post-hoc Platt recalibration
# of Brier score (see evaluation chunk, recalibrate_brier_row())
# is driven by the SAME per-cell "weighted" flag, so it is equally general --
# it activates only for cells that were actually weighted, whichever those
# turn out to be for a given dataset.
CLASS_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD <- 0.05

# ── Development mode toggle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
DEV_MODE <- FALSE   # set TRUE for fast validation, FALSE for manuscript run

if (DEV_MODE) {
  SHAP_BG_SIZE    <- 25
  SHAP_N_TEST     <- 150
  XGB_NROUNDS_MAX <- 200
  CV_FOLDS        <- 5
  ENET_TUNE       <- 10
  RF_TUNE         <- 3
} else {
  SHAP_BG_SIZE    <- 200
  SHAP_N_TEST     <- 1000   # rows of test set for SHAP; NULL = full test set
  XGB_NROUNDS_MAX <- 500
  CV_FOLDS        <- 10
  ENET_TUNE       <- 20
  RF_TUNE         <- 5
}

# ── Cache directory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Separate directories for DEV_MODE and manuscript runs so a fast validation
# pass can never be silently loaded into a reported run. Contains patient-level
# data (caret objects embed training data) -- do NOT commit to the repository.
CACHE_DIR <- if (DEV_MODE) "cache_dev" else "cache"
dir.create(CACHE_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ── Input schema check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Fails early, with readable messages, on the data problems that would otherwise
# break the pipeline or (worse) run silently with wrong values. Full format
# description: DATA_SPECIFICATION.md.
REQUIRED_COLS <- unique(c(
  BASE_EXCLUDE, ALL_OUTCOME_COLS, NOMINAL_COLS, "gap_cat",
  "HTN", "BONE", "ANDROGENS", "VITAMIN"   # endpoints of the binary-recode ranges
))

validate_dataset <- function(df, name) {
  fail <- function(...) stop(sprintf("Dataset '%s': %s", name, paste0(...)), call. = FALSE)
  warn <- function(...) warning(sprintf("Dataset '%s': %s", name, paste0(...)), call. = FALSE)

  # 1. required columns present
  miss <- setdiff(REQUIRED_COLS, names(df))
  if (length(miss) > 0)
    fail("missing required column(s): ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  # 2. binary predictor blocks are selected BY POSITION (HTN:BONE, ANDROGENS:VITAMIN)
  #    and must be coded 0/1 or 1/2 (see the note in prep_model_df() on the
  #    "- 1" shift; either coding gives identical model results).
  for (rng in list(c("HTN", "BONE"), c("ANDROGENS", "VITAMIN"))) {
    pos <- match(rng, names(df))
    if (pos[1] > pos[2])
      fail("column '", rng[1], "' must appear BEFORE '", rng[2],
           "' (they delimit a contiguous block of binary columns)")
    block <- df[, pos[1]:pos[2], drop = FALSE]
    vals  <- unique(unlist(lapply(block, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))))
    if (!(all(vals %in% c(0, 1)) || all(vals %in% c(1, 2))))
      fail("columns ", rng[1], ":", rng[2], " must be binary, coded 0/1 or 1/2; ",
           "found value(s): ", paste(head(sort(vals), 6), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # 3. outcomes: 0/1, no missing (TSH_value is the raw numeric result, not an outcome)
  for (oc in setdiff(ALL_OUTCOME_COLS, "TSH_value")) {
    v <- df[[oc]]
    if (anyNA(v))                  fail("outcome '", oc, "' contains missing values")
    if (!all(v %in% c(0, 1)))      fail("outcome '", oc, "' must be coded 0/1")
  }

  # 4. gap (days) numeric; gap_cat restricted to the four required levels
  if (!is.numeric(df$gap)) fail("'gap' must be numeric (days between LT4 order and TSH draw)")
  bad <- setdiff(unique(as.character(df$gap_cat)), GAP_CAT_LEVELS)
  if (length(bad) > 0)
    fail("gap_cat has unexpected level(s): ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
         ". Required: ", paste(GAP_CAT_LEVELS, collapse = " | "))

  # 5. non-fatal checks
  if (anyDuplicated(df$patientid) > 0)
    warn("duplicate patientid values. The train/test split is by ROW, not by patient; ",
         "repeated patients can leak across train and test. One row per patient is expected.")
  preds <- setdiff(names(df), c(BASE_EXCLUDE, ALL_OUTCOME_COLS))
  na_n  <- colSums(is.na(df[, preds, drop = FALSE]))
  if (any(na_n > 0))
    warn("missing values in predictor(s): ",
         paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(na_n)[na_n > 0], na_n[na_n > 0]), collapse = ", "),
         ". The pipeline performs NO imputation; use complete cases.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

for (nm in names(DATASETS)) validate_dataset(DATASETS[[nm]], nm)
cat("\u2713 Input data passed schema validation\n")
```

```{r helper-functions}
# ── 1. Helper functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fmt_elapsed <- function(start_time) {
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
  if (elapsed < 60) sprintf("%.0f sec", elapsed)
  else sprintf("%.1f min", elapsed / 60)
}

youden_metrics <- function(roc_obj) {
  coords <- coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden",
                   ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
  coords[1, ]
}

brier_score <- function(probs, labels_binary) {
  mean((probs - labels_binary)^2)
}

auc_ci <- function(roc_obj) {
  ci_vals <- ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "delong")
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)", ci_vals[2], ci_vals[1], ci_vals[3])
}

# Prep model dataframe for one outcome × dataset combination
prep_model_df <- function(df, outcome) {
  y <- df[[outcome]]
  df %>%
    select(-all_of(c(BASE_EXCLUDE, ALL_OUTCOME_COLS))) %>%
    # NOTE: the "- 1" below was written for 1/2-coded indicators. With 0/1-coded
    # input (as in the manuscript data) it yields -1/0 instead of 0/1. This is a
    # constant shift of a binary variable, to which every model here is invariant
    # (elastic net centres/scales; trees split identically), so results are
    # unaffected; it is retained unchanged so the reported analysis reproduces.
    mutate(
      across(HTN:BONE,          ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)) - 1),
      across(ANDROGENS:VITAMIN, ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)) - 1),
      gap_cat  = factor(gap_cat, levels = GAP_CAT_LEVELS, ordered = TRUE),
      PAT_SEX  = factor(PAT_SEX),
      PAT_RACE = factor(PAT_RACE),
      ETHNIC   = factor(ETHNIC),
      year     = factor(year),
      outcome  = factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Normal", "Event"))
    )
}

# Conditional inverse-frequency class weights (single source of truth).
# Returns the event rate of THIS training split, whether it falls below
# CLASS_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD, and (if so) per-row weights for caret's elastic net /
# random forest. XGBoost applies the same rule internally via scale_pos_weight
# (see fit_xgb()). When the event rate is >= threshold, weights = NULL and
# fitting is identical to the unweighted model.
get_class_weights <- function(train_df) {
  event_rate <- mean(train_df$outcome == "Event")
  weighted   <- event_rate < CLASS_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD
  weights <- if (weighted) {
    cat(sprintf("  [class imbalance] event rate %.1f%% — applying weights\n",
                event_rate * 100))
    counts <- table(train_df$outcome)
    ifelse(train_df$outcome == "Event",
           as.numeric(counts["Normal"] / counts["Event"]),
           1.0)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  list(weights = weights, weighted = weighted, event_rate = event_rate)
}

# Restore nominal factor columns after dummy decoding
restore_factors <- function(newdata, factor_levels) {
  if (!is.data.frame(newdata)) newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  for (col in names(factor_levels)) {
    if (col %in% names(newdata)) {
      newdata[[col]] <- factor(newdata[[col]], levels = factor_levels[[col]])
    }
  }
  newdata
}

# Reconstruct nominal factor columns from dummy-expanded columns
decode_dummies <- function(newdata, factor_cols, factor_levels) {
  for (col in factor_cols) {
    dummy_pattern <- paste0("^", col, "\\.")
    dummy_cols    <- names(newdata)[str_detect(names(newdata), dummy_pattern)]
    if (length(dummy_cols) == 0) next
    dummy_matrix <- newdata[, dummy_cols, drop = FALSE]
    level_names  <- str_remove(dummy_cols, paste0(col, "\\."))
    ref_level    <- setdiff(factor_levels[[col]], level_names)[1]
    reconstructed <- apply(dummy_matrix, 1, function(row) {
      active <- which(row == 1)
      if (length(active) == 0) ref_level else level_names[active[1]]
    })
    newdata[[col]] <- factor(reconstructed, levels = factor_levels[[col]])
    newdata        <- newdata %>% select(-all_of(dummy_cols))
  }
  newdata
}
```

```{r data-split}
# ── 2. Train/test split ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

split_data <- function(df, outcome) {
  model_df  <- prep_model_df(df, outcome)
  set.seed(SEED)
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(model_df$outcome, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  list(
    train = model_df[train_idx, ],
    test  = model_df[-train_idx, ]
  )
}
```

```{r train-control}
# ── 3. trainControl ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# verboseIter = TRUE restores the ======= progress bars during caret training

make_ctrl <- function(train_df) {
  folds <- createFolds(train_df$outcome, k = CV_FOLDS, returnTrain = TRUE)
  trainControl(
    method          = "cv",
    index           = folds,
    classProbs      = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final",
    verboseIter     = TRUE    # progress bars
  )
}
```

```{r model-fitting}
# ── 4. Model fitting functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────

fit_enet <- function(train_df, ctrl, weights = NULL) {
  set.seed(SEED)
  train(
    outcome ~ .,
    data       = train_df,
    method     = "glmnet",
    metric     = "ROC",
    trControl  = ctrl,
    preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
    tuneLength = ENET_TUNE,
    weights = weights
  )
}

fit_rf <- function(train_df, ctrl, weights = NULL) {
  set.seed(SEED)
  train(
    outcome ~ .,
    data       = train_df,
    method     = "ranger",
    metric     = "ROC",
    trControl  = ctrl,
    tuneLength = RF_TUNE,
    importance = "permutation",
    weights = weights
  )
}

fit_xgb <- function(train_df) {
  train_features <- train_df %>% select(-outcome)
  dummy_enc <- dummyVars(~ ., data = train_features, fullRank = TRUE)
  X_train   <- predict(dummy_enc, train_features) %>% as.matrix()
  y_train   <- as.numeric(train_df$outcome == "Event")
  dtrain    <- xgb.DMatrix(X_train, label = y_train)

  n_neg <- sum(y_train == 0)
  n_pos <- sum(y_train == 1)

  # Conditional class weighting, matching fit_enet()/fit_rf()'s weighting
  # logic exactly (same <5% event-rate threshold) so all three model types
  # are treated as analogously as possible -- previously XGBoost always
  # applied scale_pos_weight regardless of event rate, while elastic net
  # and random forest only weighted below the 5% threshold.
  event_rate <- n_pos / (n_pos + n_neg)
  scale_pos_weight <- if (event_rate < CLASS_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD) {
    cat(sprintf("  [class imbalance] event rate %.1f%% — applying scale_pos_weight\n",
                event_rate * 100))
    n_neg / n_pos
  } else {
    1.0
  }

  xgb_params <- list(
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "auc",
    eta              = 0.05,
    max_depth        = 4,
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    min_child_weight = 10,
    scale_pos_weight = scale_pos_weight,
    nthread          = N_WORKERS
  )

  set.seed(SEED)
  xgb_cv <- xgb.cv(
    params                = xgb_params,
    data                  = dtrain,
    nrounds               = XGB_NROUNDS_MAX,
    nfold                 = CV_FOLDS,
    early_stopping_rounds = 30,
    verbose               = 0
  )

  best_nrounds <- if (!is.null(xgb_cv$best_iteration) &&
                      !is.na(xgb_cv$best_iteration)) {
    xgb_cv$best_iteration
  } else {
    which.max(xgb_cv$evaluation_log$test_auc_mean)
  }

  set.seed(SEED)
  xgb_fit <- xgb.train(
    params  = xgb_params,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds,
    verbose = 0
  )

  list(
    model     = xgb_fit,
    dummy_enc = dummy_enc,
    X_train   = X_train,
    y_train   = y_train,
    dtrain    = dtrain
  )
}
```

```{r calibration-functions}
# ── 5. Threshold-locking and calibration functions ────────────────────────────
#
# The Youden-optimal decision threshold is LOCKED from held-out cross-
# validation predictions on the TRAINING set (never the test set), then
# applied unchanged to test-set probabilities to obtain sensitivity/
# specificity. This is the pipeline's primary (and only reported) approach
# to threshold selection.
#
# Earlier pipeline versions selected the threshold from the SAME test-set
# ROC curve used to report AUC -- methodologically circular, and the source
# of a visibly inflated result (sensitivity = 1.000 for the TSH <0.1 outcome
# under the old approach). Locking the threshold from training-side held-out
# predictions removes that circularity. This is not an alternative or
# supplemental analysis -- it replaces the prior approach everywhere in this
# document; there is no test-derived threshold reported anywhere below.
#
# - Elastic net / random forest: NO extra retraining needed. caret's
#   trainControl uses savePredictions = "final", so fit$pred already
#   contains held-out CV predictions on the training set.
# - XGBoost: implemented as a manual stratified K-fold loop using only
#   xgb.DMatrix(), xgb.train(), and predict() -- deliberately avoiding
#   xgb.cv() and its internal callback objects (e.g. cb.cv.predict), since
#   those have proven inconsistent across xgboost versions. Preferred:
#   nrounds is read directly from the fitted model object; if that can't be
#   read, each fold falls back to picking its own nrounds via early stopping
#   on an internal validation split carved out of that fold's training data.

locked_threshold_from_cv <- function(pred_df) {
  if (!all(c("obs", "Event") %in% names(pred_df))) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "pred_df is missing required column(s): %s. Available columns: %s",
      paste(setdiff(c("obs", "Event"), names(pred_df)), collapse = ", "),
      paste(names(pred_df), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  roc_train <- roc(pred_df$obs, pred_df$Event,
                    levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)
  yd <- youden_metrics(roc_train)
  as.numeric(yd$threshold)
}

# Apply a fixed threshold to a test-set ROC object via pROC's own
# threshold-to-classification convention.
apply_locked_threshold <- function(roc_obj, threshold) {
  co <- coords(roc_obj, x = threshold, input = "threshold",
               ret = c("sensitivity", "specificity"))
  list(sensitivity = as.numeric(co$sensitivity[1]),
       specificity = as.numeric(co$specificity[1]))
}

# Try several ways to read how many boosting rounds a fitted model used;
# xgboost's Booster internals have not been consistent across versions
# about where/whether this is exposed (especially after saveRDS/readRDS).
get_n_rounds <- function(booster) {
  candidates <- list(
    function() booster$niter,
    function() attr(booster, "niter"),
    function() as.integer(xgboost::xgb.attr(booster, "niter")),
    function() as.integer(xgboost::xgb.attr(booster, "best_iteration")) + 1L,
    function() length(unique(xgboost::xgb.model.dt.tree(model = booster)$Tree))
  )
  for (f in candidates) {
    val <- tryCatch(f(), error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL)
    if (!is.null(val) && length(val) == 1 && !is.na(val) && val >= 1) {
      return(as.integer(val))
    }
  }
  NULL
}

# Recover out-of-fold TRAINING predictions for a fitted XGBoost model,
# without depending on xgb.cv()'s internal callback API. Needed for BOTH
# threshold-locking (evaluate_model(), below) and Platt recalibration.
get_xgb_cv_preds <- function(xgb_obj) {
  n_neg  <- sum(xgb_obj$y_train == 0)
  n_pos  <- sum(xgb_obj$y_train == 1)
  # Matches fit_xgb()'s conditional weighting exactly (same threshold)
  event_rate       <- n_pos / (n_pos + n_neg)
  scale_pos_weight <- if (event_rate < CLASS_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD) n_neg / n_pos else 1.0
  params <- list(
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "auc",
    eta              = 0.05,
    max_depth        = 4,
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    min_child_weight = 10,
    scale_pos_weight = scale_pos_weight,
    nthread          = N_WORKERS
  )

  y <- xgb_obj$y_train
  X <- xgb_obj$X_train
  n <- length(y)

  n_rounds <- get_n_rounds(xgb_obj$model)
  use_early_stopping <- is.null(n_rounds)
  if (use_early_stopping) {
    cat("    [note] Could not read boosting rounds from model object;",
        "each fold will pick its own via early stopping.\n")
  }

  set.seed(SEED)
  fold_id <- integer(n)
  for (cls in unique(y)) {
    idx <- sample(which(y == cls))
    fold_id[idx] <- rep(seq_len(CV_FOLDS), length.out = length(idx))
  }

  oof_pred <- numeric(n)
  for (k in seq_len(CV_FOLDS)) {
    train_idx <- which(fold_id != k)
    test_idx  <- which(fold_id == k)

    dte <- xgb.DMatrix(X[test_idx, , drop = FALSE])
    set.seed(SEED + k)

    if (use_early_stopping) {
      watch_n   <- max(1, floor(0.1 * length(train_idx)))
      watch_idx <- sample(train_idx, watch_n)
      fit_idx   <- setdiff(train_idx, watch_idx)

      dtr    <- xgb.DMatrix(X[fit_idx, , drop = FALSE],   label = y[fit_idx])
      dwatch <- xgb.DMatrix(X[watch_idx, , drop = FALSE], label = y[watch_idx])

      bst <- xgb.train(
        params                = params,
        data                  = dtr,
        nrounds               = 500,
        watchlist             = list(watch = dwatch),
        early_stopping_rounds = 30,
        verbose                = 0
      )
    } else {
      dtr <- xgb.DMatrix(X[train_idx, , drop = FALSE], label = y[train_idx])
      bst <- xgb.train(params = params, data = dtr, nrounds = n_rounds, verbose = 0)
    }

    oof_pred[test_idx] <- predict(bst, dte)
  }

  tibble(
    obs   = factor(ifelse(y == 1, "Event", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal", "Event")),
    Event = oof_pred
  )
}

# ── Post-hoc Platt recalibration for weighted models ──────────────────────────
#
# Class weighting (applied conditionally when event rate < CLASS_WEIGHT_
# THRESHOLD, matched across all three model types) shifts predicted
# probabilities toward the reweighted class balance rather than the true
# population -- this distorts Brier score specifically. Platt scaling is a
# monotonic logistic transform of the predicted probability, fit on held-out
# CV predictions (never test-set data) and applied to test-set probabilities.
# Because it's monotonic, it CANNOT change AUC, sensitivity, or specificity
# at any threshold -- only Brier score changes. Applied uniformly to every
# model that was actually weighted for a given cell (never partially, for
# the same cross-model-consistency reasons weighting itself is applied
# uniformly).
#
# IMPORTANT FOR REPRODUCIBILITY / REPLICATION ON OTHER DATA: neither the
# weighting decision nor this recalibration step is tied to any specific
# outcome name (e.g. "TSH_0.1"). Every loop below computes `event_rate` from
# its own current training split and derives per-model `*_weighted` flags
# from that value at runtime. recalibrate_brier_row() only recalibrates when
# its `weighted` argument is TRUE. On a dataset where a DIFFERENT outcome
# (or several, or none) crosses CLASS_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD, this logic activates
# for whichever cells that turns out to be, automatically, with no code
# changes required. In this study's data, only TSH <0.1 mIU/L happens to
# fall below the threshold (confirmed by checking event rate across every
# outcome x dataset x stratum combination in the pipeline) -- that is a
# property of this cohort, not an assumption baked into the code.

qlogis_safe <- function(p, eps = 1e-6) {
  qlogis(pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps))
}

fit_platt <- function(cv_pred_df) {
  y       <- as.numeric(cv_pred_df$obs == "Event")
  logit_p <- qlogis_safe(cv_pred_df$Event)
  glm(y ~ logit_p, family = binomial())
}

apply_platt <- function(platt_model, probs) {
  newdata <- data.frame(logit_p = qlogis_safe(probs))
  as.numeric(predict(platt_model, newdata = newdata, type = "response"))
}
```

```{r evaluation}
# ── 6. Evaluation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# evaluate_model() reports AUC, Brier score, and sensitivity/specificity at
# the LOCKED (train/CV-derived) Youden threshold -- see calibration-functions
# chunk above for the full rationale. model_type and fit_obj are required so
# the held-out CV predictions needed to lock the threshold can be recovered
# (fit_obj$pred for elastic net/random forest; a manual CV loop via
# get_xgb_cv_preds() for XGBoost, since xgb.cv()'s prediction-callback API
# has proven inconsistent across xgboost versions).

evaluate_model <- function(probs, truth_factor, truth_binary,
                           model_name, outcome, dataset,
                           model_type, fit_obj) {
  roc_obj <- roc(truth_factor, probs,
                 levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

  cv_pred_df <- if (model_type == "xgb") {
    get_xgb_cv_preds(fit_obj)
  } else {
    fit_obj$pred %>% select(obs, Event)
  }
  threshold <- locked_threshold_from_cv(cv_pred_df)
  metrics   <- apply_locked_threshold(roc_obj, threshold)

  tibble(
    dataset     = dataset,
    outcome     = outcome,
    model       = model_name,
    auc_ci      = auc_ci(roc_obj),
    auc_num     = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    brier       = round(brier_score(probs, truth_binary), 3),
    threshold   = round(threshold, 4),
    sensitivity = round(metrics$sensitivity, 3),
    specificity = round(metrics$specificity, 3)
  )
}

# Given an evaluate_model() result row, recompute Brier using Platt-
# recalibrated probabilities IF this model was actually weighted for this
# cell; otherwise returns the row unchanged (with brier_raw == brier and
# calibrated == FALSE, for a consistent schema across all rows).
recalibrate_brier_row <- function(result_row, weighted, model_type, fit_obj,
                                   test_probs, truth_binary) {
  result_row$brier_raw  <- result_row$brier
  result_row$calibrated <- FALSE
  if (!isTRUE(weighted)) return(result_row)

  cv_pred_df <- if (model_type == "xgb") {
    get_xgb_cv_preds(fit_obj)
  } else {
    fit_obj$pred %>% select(obs, Event)
  }
  platt_model      <- fit_platt(cv_pred_df)
  calibrated_probs <- apply_platt(platt_model, test_probs)

  result_row$brier      <- round(brier_score(calibrated_probs, truth_binary), 3)
  result_row$calibrated <- TRUE
  result_row
}
```

```{r shap-functions}
# ── 6. SHAP functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Build dummy encoder for SHAP — ordered categoricals converted to integer,
# nominal categoricals dummy-expanded. Uses intersect() so columns absent
# from a given dataset (e.g. gap_cat in full dataset) are silently skipped.
make_shap_dummy_encoder <- function(train_df) {
  train_features <- train_df %>% select(-outcome)
  ordered_cols   <- intersect(ORDERED_COLS, names(train_features))
  train_features <- train_features %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(ordered_cols), ~ as.numeric(.x)))
  dummyVars(~ ., data = train_features, fullRank = TRUE, sep = ".")
}

# Internal helper: build encoded train/test matrices and background sample
.build_shap_inputs <- function(train_df, test_df, dummy_enc) {
  train_features <- train_df %>% select(-outcome)
  test_features  <- test_df  %>% select(-outcome)
  ordered_cols   <- intersect(ORDERED_COLS, names(train_features))

  encode_ordered <- function(df) {
    df %>% mutate(across(any_of(ordered_cols), ~ as.numeric(.x)))
  }

  X_train_enc <- predict(dummy_enc, encode_ordered(train_features)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  X_test_enc  <- predict(dummy_enc, encode_ordered(test_features)) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  X_shap <- if (!is.null(SHAP_N_TEST) && nrow(X_test_enc) > SHAP_N_TEST) {
    set.seed(SEED)
    X_test_enc[sample(nrow(X_test_enc), SHAP_N_TEST), ]
  } else {
    X_test_enc
  }

  set.seed(SEED)
  bg <- X_train_enc[sample(nrow(X_train_enc),
                           min(SHAP_BG_SIZE, nrow(X_train_enc))), ]

  list(
    X_shap         = X_shap,
    bg             = bg,
    ordered_cols   = ordered_cols,
    train_features = train_features
  )
}

# Build prediction wrapper for caret models (enet / rf)
# Restores ordered factors and nominal factors from dummy-encoded matrix
.make_caret_pred_fun <- function(train_features, ordered_cols, ordered_levels) {
  factor_levels <- lapply(NOMINAL_COLS,
                          function(col) levels(train_features[[col]]))
  names(factor_levels) <- NOMINAL_COLS

  function(model, newdata) {
    newdata_df <- as.data.frame(newdata)

    if (length(ordered_cols) > 0) {
      newdata_df <- newdata_df %>%
        mutate(across(any_of(ordered_cols), function(x) {
          col_name <- cur_column()
          lvls <- ordered_levels[[col_name]]
          factor(lvls[round(x)], levels = lvls, ordered = TRUE)
        }))
    }

    newdata_df <- decode_dummies(newdata_df, NOMINAL_COLS, factor_levels)
    newdata_df <- restore_factors(newdata_df, factor_levels)
    predict(model, newdata_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
  }
}

compute_shap_enet <- function(enet_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = NULL) {
  if (is.null(dummy_enc)) dummy_enc <- make_shap_dummy_encoder(train_df)

  # Capture ordered factor levels BEFORE numeric conversion
  train_features <- train_df %>% select(-outcome)
  ordered_cols   <- intersect(ORDERED_COLS, names(train_features))
  ordered_levels <- lapply(ordered_cols,
                           function(col) levels(train_features[[col]]))
  names(ordered_levels) <- ordered_cols

  inputs   <- .build_shap_inputs(train_df, test_df, dummy_enc)
  pred_fun <- .make_caret_pred_fun(inputs$train_features,
                                   inputs$ordered_cols,
                                   ordered_levels)

  cat("\n  Starting enet SHAP...\n")
  t <- Sys.time()
  ks <- kernelshap(
    object   = enet_fit,
    X        = inputs$X_shap,
    bg_X     = inputs$bg,
    pred_fun = pred_fun,
    parallel = TRUE,
    verbose  = TRUE
  )
  cat(sprintf("  Enet SHAP done in %s\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
  sv <- shapviz(ks$S, X = inputs$X_shap)
  stopifnot(inherits(sv, "shapviz"))
  sv
}

compute_shap_rf <- function(rf_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = NULL) {
  if (is.null(dummy_enc)) dummy_enc <- make_shap_dummy_encoder(train_df)

  train_features <- train_df %>% select(-outcome)
  ordered_cols   <- intersect(ORDERED_COLS, names(train_features))
  ordered_levels <- lapply(ordered_cols,
                           function(col) levels(train_features[[col]]))
  names(ordered_levels) <- ordered_cols

  inputs   <- .build_shap_inputs(train_df, test_df, dummy_enc)
  pred_fun <- .make_caret_pred_fun(inputs$train_features,
                                   inputs$ordered_cols,
                                   ordered_levels)

  cat("\n  Starting RF SHAP...\n")
  t <- Sys.time()
  ks <- kernelshap(
    object   = rf_fit,
    X        = inputs$X_shap,
    bg_X     = inputs$bg,
    pred_fun = pred_fun,
    parallel = TRUE,
    verbose  = TRUE
  )
  cat(sprintf("  RF SHAP done in %s\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
  sv <- shapviz(ks$S, X = inputs$X_shap)
  stopifnot(inherits(sv, "shapviz"))
  sv
}


compute_shap_xgb <- function(xgb_obj, test_df) {
  cat("\n  Starting XGBoost SHAP...\n")
  t      <- Sys.time()
  X_test <- predict(xgb_obj$dummy_enc,
                    test_df %>% select(-outcome)) %>% as.matrix()
  sv     <- shapviz(xgb_obj$model, X_pred = X_test)
  cat(sprintf("  XGBoost SHAP done in %s\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
  sv
}
```

# ── 7. SHAP plot functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

make_shap_plot <- function(sv_obj, title_str) {
  sv_importance(
    sv_obj,
    kind            = "beeswarm",
    max_display     = N_SHAP_FEATURES,
    color_bar_title = "Feature value"
  ) +
    labs(title = title_str) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

make_shap_bar_plot <- function(sv_obj, title_str) {
  sv_importance(
    sv_obj,
    kind        = "bar",
    max_display = N_SHAP_FEATURES,
    fill        = "#2166ac"
  ) +
    labs(title = title_str, x = "Mean |SHAP value|", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

```{r main-loop}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 8. MAIN LOOP — all outcome × dataset combinations
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

results_list <- list()
shap_list    <- list()
roc_list     <- list()

loop_start   <- Sys.time()
total_iter   <- length(DATASETS) * length(OUTCOMES)
iter_n       <- 0

for (ds_name in names(DATASETS)) {

  df <- DATASETS[[ds_name]]

  for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {

    iter_n     <- iter_n + 1
    iter_start <- Sys.time()
    key        <- paste(ds_name, outcome, sep = "_")

    cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] ══ Dataset: %s | Outcome: %s ══\n",
                iter_n, total_iter, ds_name, outcome))

    # ── Split
    splits       <- split_data(df, outcome)
    train_df     <- splits$train
    test_df      <- splits$test
    truth_factor <- test_df$outcome
    truth_binary <- as.numeric(test_df$outcome == "Event")
    ctrl         <- make_ctrl(train_df)

    # Conditional class weighting, evaluated on THIS iteration's training split
    # (same rule for all three model types; see get_class_weights()).
    cw            <- get_class_weights(train_df)
    event_rate    <- cw$event_rate
    model_weights <- cw$weights
    enet_weighted <- rf_weighted <- xgb_weighted <- cw$weighted

    # Build shared SHAP dummy encoder once per iteration (reused for enet + rf)
    shap_enc <- make_shap_dummy_encoder(train_df)

    # ── Elastic net ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    t          <- Sys.time()
    enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_enet.rds"))
    cat("  [1/3] Elastic net... ")
    if (file.exists(enet_cache)) {
      enet_fit <- readRDS(enet_cache)
      cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      enet_fit <- fit_enet(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(enet_fit, enet_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    enet_probs <- predict(enet_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(enet_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Elastic Net", outcome, ds_name,
                     model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit),
      weighted = enet_weighted, model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit,
      test_probs = enet_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)
    roc_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- roc(
      truth_factor, enet_probs, levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

    # ── Random forest ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    t        <- Sys.time()
    rf_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_rf.rds"))
    cat("  [2/3] Random forest... ")
    if (file.exists(rf_cache)) {
      rf_fit <- readRDS(rf_cache)
      cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      rf_fit <- fit_rf(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(rf_fit, rf_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    rf_probs <- predict(rf_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(rf_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Random Forest", outcome, ds_name,
                     model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit),
      weighted = rf_weighted, model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit,
      test_probs = rf_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)
    roc_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- roc(
      truth_factor, rf_probs, levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

    # ── XGBoost ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    t         <- Sys.time()
    xgb_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_xgb.rds"))
    cat("  [3/3] XGBoost... ")
    if (file.exists(xgb_cache)) {
      xgb_obj <- readRDS(xgb_cache)
      cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      xgb_obj <- fit_xgb(train_df)
      saveRDS(xgb_obj, xgb_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    xgb_dm    <- xgb.DMatrix(
      predict(xgb_obj$dummy_enc, test_df %>% select(-outcome)) %>% as.matrix())
    xgb_probs <- predict(xgb_obj$model, xgb_dm)
    results_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(xgb_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "XGBoost", outcome, ds_name,
                     model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj),
      weighted = xgb_weighted, model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj,
      test_probs = xgb_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)
    roc_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- roc(
      truth_factor, xgb_probs, levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

    # ── SHAP (with caching) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    cat("  Computing SHAP values...\n")

    shap_enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_enet.rds"))
    shap_rf_cache   <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_rf.rds"))
    shap_xgb_cache  <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_xgb.rds"))

    if (file.exists(shap_enet_cache)) {
      shap_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- readRDS(shap_enet_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 1/3] Enet loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <-
        compute_shap_enet(enet_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]], shap_enet_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_rf_cache)) {
      shap_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- readRDS(shap_rf_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 2/3] RF loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <-
        compute_shap_rf(rf_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]], shap_rf_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_xgb_cache)) {
      shap_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- readRDS(shap_xgb_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 3/3] XGBoost loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <-
        compute_shap_xgb(xgb_obj, test_df)
      saveRDS(shap_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]], shap_xgb_cache)
    }

    # ── Iteration summary
    iter_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), iter_start, units = "secs"))
    eta_secs     <- iter_elapsed * (total_iter - iter_n)
    cat(sprintf("  \u2014 Iteration done in %s | ETA: %s\n",
                fmt_elapsed(iter_start),
                if (iter_n < total_iter) sprintf("~%.1f min", eta_secs / 60)
                else "done"))
  }
}

cat(sprintf("\n\u2713 Primary loop completed in %s\n", fmt_elapsed(loop_start)))

# Sanity check — confirm all shapviz objects built correctly
for (key in names(shap_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %s\n", key, paste(class(shap_list[[key]]), collapse = ", ")))
}
```

```{r delong-tests}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DELONG PAIRWISE AUC COMPARISONS — Primary analysis, full dataset
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

delong_results <- purrr::map_dfr(OUTCOMES, function(outcome) {
  key <- paste("full", outcome, sep = "_")
  
  roc_en  <- roc_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]]
  roc_rf  <- roc_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]]
  roc_xgb <- roc_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]]
  
  get_p <- function(r1, r2) {
    test <- roc.test(r1, r2, method = "delong")
    test$p.value
  }
  
  tibble(
    outcome        = outcome,
    EN_vs_RF       = get_p(roc_en,  roc_rf),
    EN_vs_XGB      = get_p(roc_en,  roc_xgb),
    RF_vs_XGB      = get_p(roc_rf,  roc_xgb)
  )
})

# Format for display and annotation
delong_fmt <- delong_results %>%
  mutate(across(EN_vs_RF:RF_vs_XGB, ~ {
    ifelse(.x < 0.001, "<0.001",
           ifelse(.x < 0.01, sprintf("%.3f", .x),
                  sprintf("%.2f", .x)))
  }))

cat("\n── DeLong pairwise AUC comparisons (full dataset) ──\n")
print(delong_fmt)
```

```{r delong-table}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DELONG TABLE — pairwise AUC comparisons with raw, Bonferroni, and Holm p-values
# Primary analysis, full dataset only
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Compute raw p-values
delong_long <- purrr::map_dfr(OUTCOMES, function(outcome) {
  key <- paste("full", outcome, sep = "_")
  
  roc_en  <- roc_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]]
  roc_rf  <- roc_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]]
  roc_xgb <- roc_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]]
  
  tibble(
    outcome     = outcome_nice[outcome],
    comparison  = c("Elastic Net vs. Random Forest",
                    "Elastic Net vs. XGBoost",
                    "Random Forest vs. XGBoost"),
    p_raw       = c(roc.test(roc_en,  roc_rf,  method = "delong")$p.value,
                    roc.test(roc_en,  roc_xgb, method = "delong")$p.value,
                    roc.test(roc_rf,  roc_xgb, method = "delong")$p.value)
  )
})

# ── Apply corrections across all 9 tests
delong_long <- delong_long %>%
  mutate(
    p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "bonferroni"),
    p_holm       = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "holm")
  )

# ── Format p-values
fmt_p <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE       ~ sprintf("%.3f", x)
  )
}

delong_display <- delong_long %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("p_"), fmt_p))

# ── Flextable
ft_delong <- delong_display %>%
  rename(
    Outcome      = outcome,
    Comparison   = comparison,
    `Raw`        = p_raw,
    `Bonferroni` = p_bonferroni,
    `Holm`       = p_holm
  ) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  add_header_row(
    values    = c("", "", "p-value"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 3)
  ) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Outcome") %>%
  merge_h_range(i = 1, j1 = 3, j2 = 5, part = "header") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "left",   j = 1:2, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "center", j = 3:5, part = "all") %>%
  bg(bg = "white", part = "all") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "header") %>%
  hline(i = 1, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
  hline(i = 2, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "body") %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 1.5) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 2.2) %>%
  width(j = 3:5, width = 1.0) %>%
  add_footer_lines(
    "DeLong's method used for all pairwise AUC comparisons on the held-out test set. Bonferroni and Holm corrections applied across all 9 tests (3 comparisons \u00d7 3 outcomes). Primary analysis, comprehensive dataset only."
  ) %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "footer") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "footer") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "footer")

# ── Write to Word
doc_delong <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("DeLong Pairwise AUC Comparisons \u2014 Primary Analysis",
               style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Pairwise DeLong tests comparing AUC between all three models for each primary outcome (comprehensive dataset, held-out test set). Raw p-values and two multiple comparison corrections are reported.",
    style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_delong)

print(doc_delong, target = "./DeLong_AUC_comparisons.docx")
cat("\u2713 DeLong table written to DeLong_AUC_comparisons.docx\n")

For outcomes with event frequency <5%, all three model types were conditionally class-weighted; Brier scores for these cells reflect post-hoc Platt recalibration (fit on held-out cross-validation predictions) to correct the calibration shift introduced by weighting -- AUC and Sens/Spec are unaffected, as this is a monotonic transform."

```{r roc-figures}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 12. ROC CURVE FIGURES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

roc_colors    <- c("Elastic Net" = "#2166ac", "Random Forest" = "#d6604d",
                   "XGBoost"     = "#4dac26")
roc_linetypes <- c("Elastic Net" = "solid",   "Random Forest" = "dashed",
                   "XGBoost"     = "dotdash")

make_roc_plot <- function(roc_objects, winner_model, outcome_str, dataset_str) {

  roc_df <- purrr::map_dfr(names(roc_objects), function(mdl_name) {
    roc_obj   <- roc_objects[[mdl_name]]
    auc_val   <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
    leg_label <- if (mdl_name == winner_model) {
      sprintf("%s* (AUC = %.3f)", mdl_name, auc_val)
    } else {
      sprintf("%s (AUC = %.3f)", mdl_name, auc_val)
    }
    tibble(specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
           sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
           model = mdl_name, label = leg_label)
  })

  auc_order     <- map_dbl(names(roc_objects),
                           ~ as.numeric(auc(roc_objects[[.x]])))
  names(auc_order) <- names(roc_objects)
  ordered_models   <- names(sort(auc_order, decreasing = TRUE))
  label_map        <- roc_df %>% distinct(model, label) %>%
    slice(match(ordered_models, model))
  roc_df <- roc_df %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label_map$label))

  ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity,
                     color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(roc_colors[ordered_models], label_map$label)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = setNames(roc_linetypes[ordered_models], label_map$label)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2),
                       labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2),
                       labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(title   = sprintf("%s \u2014 %s", outcome_str, dataset_str),
         x       = "1 \u2212 Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
         y       = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
         color   = NULL, linetype = NULL,
         caption = "* Winning model (highest AUC)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position   = c(0.65, 0.18),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray80",
                                       linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width  = unit(1.5, "cm"),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      axis.text         = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

roc_plots <- list()

for (ds_name in names(DATASETS)) {
  for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
    key <- paste(ds_name, outcome, sep = "_")
    roc_objects <- list(
      "Elastic Net"   = roc_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]],
      "Random Forest" = roc_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]],
      "XGBoost"       = roc_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]]
    )
    winner_model <- winners %>%
      filter(dataset == .env$ds_name, outcome == .env$outcome) %>%
      pull(winning_model) %>% .[1]
    roc_plots[[key]] <- make_roc_plot(
      roc_objects, winner_model,
      outcome_nice[outcome], dataset_nice[ds_name])
    cat(sprintf("  \u2713 ROC plot: %s\n", key))
  }
}

```{r stratified-setup-on-reduced-dataset}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPPLEMENTAL ANALYSIS — Follow-up Interval Stratification
# Dataset: ds.reduced only; gap <= 90 vs gap > 90
# gap and gap_cat excluded as features (they define the stratification)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

MIN_STRATUM_N <- 200

ds.reduced_recent  <- ds.reduced %>% filter(gap <= 90)
ds.reduced_distant <- ds.reduced %>% filter(gap > 90)

cat(sprintf("Recent  (gap \u226490 days): N = %d\n", nrow(ds.reduced_recent)))
cat(sprintf("Distant (gap  >90 days): N = %d\n", nrow(ds.reduced_distant)))

STRATA <- list(recent = ds.reduced_recent, distant = ds.reduced_distant)

stratum_labels <- c(
  recent  = "Recent order (\u226490 days)",
  distant = "Distant order (>90 days)"
)

# ── Pre-flight sample size check
cat("\n── Pre-flight sample size check ─────────────────\n")
for (stratum_name in names(STRATA)) {
  for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
    event_n <- sum(STRATA[[stratum_name]][[outcome]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    total_n <- nrow(STRATA[[stratum_name]])
    symbol  <- if (event_n < MIN_STRATUM_N) "\u26a0 WARNING:" else "\u2713"
    cat(sprintf("  %s %s | %s \u2014 %d events (N=%d)\n",
                symbol, stratum_name, outcome, event_n, total_n))
  }
}
cat("──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# ── Modified prep — excludes gap and gap_cat
prep_model_df_strat <- function(df, outcome) {
  y <- df[[outcome]]
  df %>%
    select(-all_of(intersect(
      c(BASE_EXCLUDE, ALL_OUTCOME_COLS, "gap", "gap_cat"),
      names(df)
    ))) %>%
    # NOTE: the "- 1" below was written for 1/2-coded indicators. With 0/1-coded
    # input (as in the manuscript data) it yields -1/0 instead of 0/1. This is a
    # constant shift of a binary variable, to which every model here is invariant
    # (elastic net centres/scales; trees split identically), so results are
    # unaffected; it is retained unchanged so the reported analysis reproduces.
    mutate(
      across(HTN:BONE,          ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)) - 1),
      across(ANDROGENS:VITAMIN, ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)) - 1),
      PAT_SEX  = factor(PAT_SEX),
      PAT_RACE = factor(PAT_RACE),
      ETHNIC   = factor(ETHNIC),
      year     = factor(year),
      outcome  = factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Normal", "Event"))
    )
}

split_data_strat <- function(df, outcome) {
  model_df  <- prep_model_df_strat(df, outcome)
  set.seed(SEED)
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(model_df$outcome, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  list(train = model_df[train_idx, ], test = model_df[-train_idx, ])
}
```

```{r stratified-loop-on-reduced-dataset}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STRATIFIED MAIN LOOP
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

results_list_strat <- list()
shap_list_strat    <- list()

loop_start_strat <- Sys.time()
total_iter_strat <- length(STRATA) * length(OUTCOMES)
iter_strat       <- 0

for (stratum_name in names(STRATA)) {

  df <- STRATA[[stratum_name]]

  for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {

    iter_strat <- iter_strat + 1
    iter_start <- Sys.time()
    key        <- paste(stratum_name, outcome, sep = "_")

    cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] ══ Stratum: %s | Outcome: %s ══\n",
                iter_strat, total_iter_strat, stratum_name, outcome))

    splits       <- split_data_strat(df, outcome)
    train_df     <- splits$train
    test_df      <- splits$test
    truth_factor <- test_df$outcome
    truth_binary <- as.numeric(test_df$outcome == "Event")
    ctrl         <- make_ctrl(train_df)
    shap_enc     <- make_shap_dummy_encoder(train_df)

    cw            <- get_class_weights(train_df)
    event_rate    <- cw$event_rate
    model_weights <- cw$weights
    enet_weighted <- rf_weighted <- xgb_weighted <- cw$weighted

    # ── Elastic net
    t          <- Sys.time()
    enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_enet.rds"))
    cat("  [1/3] Elastic net... ")
    if (file.exists(enet_cache)) {
      enet_fit <- readRDS(enet_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      enet_fit <- fit_enet(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(enet_fit, enet_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    enet_probs <- predict(enet_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(enet_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Elastic Net", outcome, stratum_name,
                     model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit),
      weighted = enet_weighted, model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit,
      test_probs = enet_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)

    # ── Random forest
    t        <- Sys.time()
    rf_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_rf.rds"))
    cat("  [2/3] Random forest... ")
    if (file.exists(rf_cache)) {
      rf_fit <- readRDS(rf_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      rf_fit <- fit_rf(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(rf_fit, rf_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    rf_probs <- predict(rf_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(rf_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Random Forest", outcome, stratum_name,
                     model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit),
      weighted = rf_weighted, model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit,
      test_probs = rf_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)

    # ── XGBoost
    t         <- Sys.time()
    xgb_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_xgb.rds"))
    cat("  [3/3] XGBoost... ")
    if (file.exists(xgb_cache)) {
      xgb_obj <- readRDS(xgb_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      xgb_obj <- fit_xgb(train_df)
      saveRDS(xgb_obj, xgb_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    xgb_dm    <- xgb.DMatrix(
      predict(xgb_obj$dummy_enc, test_df %>% select(-outcome)) %>% as.matrix())
    xgb_probs <- predict(xgb_obj$model, xgb_dm)
    results_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(xgb_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "XGBoost", outcome, stratum_name,
                     model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj),
      weighted = xgb_weighted, model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj,
      test_probs = xgb_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)

    # ── SHAP (with caching)
    cat("  Computing SHAP values...\n")

    shap_enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_enet.rds"))
    shap_rf_cache   <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_rf.rds"))
    shap_xgb_cache  <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_xgb.rds"))

    if (file.exists(shap_enet_cache)) {
      shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- readRDS(shap_enet_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 1/3] Enet loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <-
        compute_shap_enet(enet_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]], shap_enet_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_rf_cache)) {
      shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- readRDS(shap_rf_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 2/3] RF loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <-
        compute_shap_rf(rf_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]], shap_rf_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_xgb_cache)) {
      shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- readRDS(shap_xgb_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 3/3] XGBoost loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <-
        compute_shap_xgb(xgb_obj, test_df)
      saveRDS(shap_list_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]], shap_xgb_cache)
    }

    iter_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), iter_start, units = "secs"))
    eta_secs     <- iter_elapsed * (total_iter_strat - iter_strat)
    cat(sprintf("  \u2014 Iteration done in %s | ETA: %s\n",
                fmt_elapsed(iter_start),
                if (iter_strat < total_iter_strat)
                  sprintf("~%.1f min", eta_secs / 60) else "done"))
  }
}

cat(sprintf("\n\u2713 Stratified loop completed in %s\n", fmt_elapsed(loop_start_strat)))

```{r stratified-table-on-reduced-dataset}
# ── Performance table
perf_wide_strat <- results_df_strat %>%
  mutate(
    outcome   = outcome_labels[outcome],
    dataset   = stratum_labels[dataset],
    is_winner = paste(dataset, outcome, model) %in%
      paste(stratum_labels[winners_strat$dataset],
            outcome_labels[winners_strat$outcome],
            winners_strat$winning_model),
    cell       = sprintf("%s\n%.3f / %.3f", auc_ci, sensitivity, specificity),
    cell       = if_else(is_winner, paste0(cell, " \u2020"), cell),
    brier_cell = as.character(brier)
  ) %>%
  select(dataset, outcome, model, cell, brier_cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(cell, brier_cell),
              names_glue = "{model}_{.value}")

all_cols_strat    <- names(perf_wide_strat)
model_names_strat <- unique(results_df_strat$model)
model_col_counts_strat <- sapply(model_names_strat, function(m) {
  sum(grepl(m, all_cols_strat, fixed = TRUE))
})
stopifnot(all(model_col_counts_strat == 2))
n_models_strat <- length(model_names_strat)
n_total_strat  <- 2 + sum(model_col_counts_strat)

new_names_strat <- setNames(all_cols_strat, all_cols_strat)
for (m in model_names_strat) {
  new_names_strat[paste0(m, "_cell")]       <- "AUC (95% CI)\nSens / Spec"
  new_names_strat[paste0(m, "_brier_cell")] <- "Brier"
}

ft_perf_strat <- perf_wide_strat %>%
  rename(Dataset = dataset, Outcome = outcome) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(values = as.list(new_names_strat[all_cols_strat])) %>%
  add_header_row(values    = c("", "", model_names_strat),
                 colwidths = c(1, 1, rep(2, n_models_strat))) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values    = c("", "", "Follow-up Interval Stratification (Reduced Dataset)"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, sum(model_col_counts_strat))) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Dataset") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "left",   j = 1:2,             part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "center", j = 3:n_total_strat,  part = "all") %>%
  bg(bg = "white", part = "all") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "header") %>%
  hline(i = 1, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
  hline(i = 3, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "body") %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 1.4) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = 3:n_total_strat, width = 1.0) %>%
  add_footer_lines(
    "AUC = area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; Sens = sensitivity; Spec = specificity at the Youden-optimal threshold, locked from held-out cross-validation predictions on the training set and applied unchanged to test-set probabilities; Brier = Brier score. \u2020 Winning model (highest AUC) for that outcome \u00d7 stratum. gap and gap_cat excluded as features (they define the stratification variable). For outcomes with event frequency <5%, all three model types were conditionally class-weighted; Brier scores for these cells reflect post-hoc Platt recalibration to correct the calibration shift introduced by weighting -- AUC and Sens/Spec are unaffected."
  ) %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "footer") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "footer") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "footer")

```{r gap-stratified-all-on-full-dataset}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1: Gap stratification — Full dataset
# Mirrors the reduced dataset stratified analysis but uses ds.full
# Cache prefix "full_strat_" avoids collision with existing reduced strat cache
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


# ── Strata
ds.full_recent  <- ds.full %>% filter(gap <= 90)
ds.full_distant <- ds.full %>% filter(gap > 90)

cat(sprintf("Full dataset — Recent  (\u226490 days): N = %d\n", nrow(ds.full_recent)))
cat(sprintf("Full dataset — Distant  (>90 days): N = %d\n", nrow(ds.full_distant)))

STRATA_FULL <- list(recent = ds.full_recent, distant = ds.full_distant)

stratum_labels_full <- c(
  recent  = "Recent order (\u226490 days)",
  distant = "Distant order (>90 days)"
)

# ── Pre-flight check
cat("\n── Pre-flight sample size check ─────────────────\n")
for (stratum_name in names(STRATA_FULL)) {
  for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
    event_n <- sum(STRATA_FULL[[stratum_name]][[outcome]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    total_n <- nrow(STRATA_FULL[[stratum_name]])
    symbol  <- if (event_n < MIN_STRATUM_N) "\u26a0 WARNING:" else "\u2713"
    cat(sprintf("  %s %s | %s \u2014 %d events (N=%d)\n",
                symbol, stratum_name, outcome, event_n, total_n))
  }
}
cat("──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# ── Main loop
results_list_full_strat <- list()
shap_list_full_strat    <- list()

loop_start_fs <- Sys.time()
total_iter_fs <- length(STRATA_FULL) * length(OUTCOMES)
iter_fs       <- 0

for (stratum_name in names(STRATA_FULL)) {

  df <- STRATA_FULL[[stratum_name]]

  for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {

    iter_fs    <- iter_fs + 1
    iter_start <- Sys.time()
    key        <- paste("full_strat", stratum_name, outcome, sep = "_")

    cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] \u2550\u2550 Full strat | %s | %s \u2550\u2550\n",
                iter_fs, total_iter_fs, stratum_name, outcome))

    splits       <- split_data_strat(df, outcome)
    train_df     <- splits$train
    test_df      <- splits$test
    truth_factor <- test_df$outcome
    truth_binary <- as.numeric(test_df$outcome == "Event")
    ctrl         <- make_ctrl(train_df)
    shap_enc     <- make_shap_dummy_encoder(train_df)

    cw            <- get_class_weights(train_df)
    event_rate    <- cw$event_rate
    model_weights <- cw$weights
    enet_weighted <- rf_weighted <- xgb_weighted <- cw$weighted

    # ── Elastic net
    t          <- Sys.time()
    enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_enet.rds"))
    cat("  [1/3] Elastic net... ")
    if (file.exists(enet_cache)) {
      enet_fit <- readRDS(enet_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      enet_fit <- fit_enet(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(enet_fit, enet_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    enet_probs <- predict(enet_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(enet_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Elastic Net", outcome, stratum_name,
                     model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit),
      weighted = enet_weighted, model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit,
      test_probs = enet_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)

    # ── Random forest
    t        <- Sys.time()
    rf_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_rf.rds"))
    cat("  [2/3] Random forest... ")
    if (file.exists(rf_cache)) {
      rf_fit <- readRDS(rf_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      rf_fit <- fit_rf(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(rf_fit, rf_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    rf_probs <- predict(rf_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(rf_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Random Forest", outcome, stratum_name,
                     model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit),
      weighted = rf_weighted, model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit,
      test_probs = rf_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)

    # ── XGBoost
    t         <- Sys.time()
    xgb_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_xgb.rds"))
    cat("  [3/3] XGBoost... ")
    if (file.exists(xgb_cache)) {
      xgb_obj <- readRDS(xgb_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      xgb_obj <- fit_xgb(train_df)
      saveRDS(xgb_obj, xgb_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    xgb_dm    <- xgb.DMatrix(
      predict(xgb_obj$dummy_enc, test_df %>% select(-outcome)) %>% as.matrix())
    xgb_probs <- predict(xgb_obj$model, xgb_dm)
    results_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(xgb_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "XGBoost", outcome, stratum_name,
                     model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj),
      weighted = xgb_weighted, model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj,
      test_probs = xgb_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)

    # ── SHAP
    cat("  Computing SHAP values...\n")

    shap_enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_enet.rds"))
    shap_rf_cache   <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_rf.rds"))
    shap_xgb_cache  <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_xgb.rds"))

    if (file.exists(shap_enet_cache)) {
      shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- readRDS(shap_enet_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 1/3] Enet loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <-
        compute_shap_enet(enet_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_enet")]], shap_enet_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_rf_cache)) {
      shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- readRDS(shap_rf_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 2/3] RF loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <-
        compute_shap_rf(rf_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_rf")]], shap_rf_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_xgb_cache)) {
      shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- readRDS(shap_xgb_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 3/3] XGBoost loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <-
        compute_shap_xgb(xgb_obj, test_df)
      saveRDS(shap_list_full_strat[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]], shap_xgb_cache)
    }

    iter_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), iter_start, units = "secs"))
    eta_secs     <- iter_elapsed * (total_iter_fs - iter_fs)
    cat(sprintf("  \u2014 Iteration done in %s | ETA: %s\n",
                fmt_elapsed(iter_start),
                if (iter_fs < total_iter_fs)
                  sprintf("~%.1f min", eta_secs / 60) else "done"))
  }
}

cat(sprintf("\n\u2713 Full dataset stratified loop completed in %s\n",
            fmt_elapsed(loop_start_fs)))

# ── Results & winners
results_df_full_strat <- bind_rows(results_list_full_strat)

winners_full_strat <- results_df_full_strat %>%
  group_by(dataset, outcome) %>%
  slice_max(auc_num, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(dataset, outcome, winning_model = model)

cat("\n── Full dataset stratified winner summary ───────\n")
print(winners_full_strat)

```{r wide-bounds-analysis}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — Wide TSH Bounds (0.1–10.0)
# Outcomes: TSH_OOR_2, TSH_10, TSH_0.1
# Datasets: ds.full, ds.reduced
# Models:   Elastic Net, Random Forest, XGBoost
# Figures:  Winning models only (beeswarm + bar plots)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

OUTCOMES_WIDE <- c("TSH_OOR_2", "TSH_10", "TSH_0.1")

outcome_labels_wide <- c(
  TSH_OOR_2 = "OOR (0.1\u201310.0)",
  TSH_10    = "Above range (TSH >10.0)",
  TSH_0.1   = "Below range (TSH <0.1)"
)
outcome_nice_wide <- outcome_labels_wide   # same for this analysis

# ── Main loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

results_list_wide <- list()
shap_list_wide    <- list()
roc_list_wide     <- list()

loop_start_wide <- Sys.time()
total_iter_wide <- length(DATASETS) * length(OUTCOMES_WIDE)
iter_wide       <- 0

for (ds_name in names(DATASETS)) {

  df <- DATASETS[[ds_name]]

  for (outcome in OUTCOMES_WIDE) {

    iter_wide  <- iter_wide + 1
    iter_start <- Sys.time()
    key        <- paste("wide", ds_name, outcome, sep = "_")

    cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] ══ Wide bounds | Dataset: %s | Outcome: %s ══\n",
                iter_wide, total_iter_wide, ds_name, outcome))

    splits       <- split_data(df, outcome)
    train_df     <- splits$train
    test_df      <- splits$test
    truth_factor <- test_df$outcome
    truth_binary <- as.numeric(test_df$outcome == "Event")
    ctrl         <- make_ctrl(train_df)
    shap_enc     <- make_shap_dummy_encoder(train_df)

    # ── Conditional class weighting, evaluated on THIS iteration's training
    # split (same rule for all three model types; see get_class_weights()).
    cw            <- get_class_weights(train_df)
    event_rate    <- cw$event_rate
    model_weights <- cw$weights
    enet_weighted <- rf_weighted <- xgb_weighted <- cw$weighted

    # ── Elastic net
    t          <- Sys.time()
    enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_enet.rds"))
    cat("  [1/3] Elastic net... ")
    if (file.exists(enet_cache)) {
      enet_fit <- readRDS(enet_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      enet_fit <- fit_enet(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(enet_fit, enet_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    enet_probs <- predict(enet_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(enet_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Elastic Net", outcome, ds_name,
                     model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit),
      weighted = enet_weighted, model_type = "enet", fit_obj = enet_fit,
      test_probs = enet_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)
    roc_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- roc(
      truth_factor, enet_probs, levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

    # ── Random forest
    t        <- Sys.time()
    rf_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_rf.rds"))
    cat("  [2/3] Random forest... ")
    if (file.exists(rf_cache)) {
      rf_fit <- readRDS(rf_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      rf_fit <- fit_rf(train_df, ctrl, weights = model_weights)
      saveRDS(rf_fit, rf_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    rf_probs <- predict(rf_fit, test_df, type = "prob")[, "Event"]
    results_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(rf_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "Random Forest", outcome, ds_name,
                     model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit),
      weighted = rf_weighted, model_type = "rf", fit_obj = rf_fit,
      test_probs = rf_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)
    roc_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- roc(
      truth_factor, rf_probs, levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

    # ── XGBoost
    t         <- Sys.time()
    xgb_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_xgb.rds"))
    cat("  [3/3] XGBoost... ")
    if (file.exists(xgb_cache)) {
      xgb_obj <- readRDS(xgb_cache); cat("loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      xgb_obj <- fit_xgb(train_df)
      saveRDS(xgb_obj, xgb_cache)
      cat(sprintf("done (%s)\n", fmt_elapsed(t)))
    }
    xgb_dm    <- xgb.DMatrix(
      predict(xgb_obj$dummy_enc, test_df %>% select(-outcome)) %>% as.matrix())
    xgb_probs <- predict(xgb_obj$model, xgb_dm)
    results_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- recalibrate_brier_row(
      evaluate_model(xgb_probs, truth_factor, truth_binary, "XGBoost", outcome, ds_name,
                     model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj),
      weighted = xgb_weighted, model_type = "xgb", fit_obj = xgb_obj,
      test_probs = xgb_probs, truth_binary = truth_binary)
    roc_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- roc(
      truth_factor, xgb_probs, levels = c("Normal", "Event"), quiet = TRUE)

    # ── SHAP (with caching)
    cat("  Computing SHAP values...\n")

    shap_enet_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_enet.rds"))
    shap_rf_cache   <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_rf.rds"))
    shap_xgb_cache  <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(key, "_shap_xgb.rds"))

    if (file.exists(shap_enet_cache)) {
      shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <- readRDS(shap_enet_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 1/3] Enet loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_enet")]] <-
        compute_shap_enet(enet_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_enet")]], shap_enet_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_rf_cache)) {
      shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <- readRDS(shap_rf_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 2/3] RF loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_rf")]] <-
        compute_shap_rf(rf_fit, train_df, test_df, dummy_enc = shap_enc)
      saveRDS(shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_rf")]], shap_rf_cache)
    }

    if (file.exists(shap_xgb_cache)) {
      shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <- readRDS(shap_xgb_cache)
      cat("  [SHAP 3/3] XGBoost loaded from cache\n")
    } else {
      shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]] <-
        compute_shap_xgb(xgb_obj, test_df)
      saveRDS(shap_list_wide[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]], shap_xgb_cache)
    }

    iter_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), iter_start, units = "secs"))
    eta_secs     <- iter_elapsed * (total_iter_wide - iter_wide)
    cat(sprintf("  \u2014 Iteration done in %s | ETA: %s\n",
                fmt_elapsed(iter_start),
                if (iter_wide < total_iter_wide)
                  sprintf("~%.1f min", eta_secs / 60) else "done"))
  }
}

cat(sprintf("\n\u2713 Wide bounds loop completed in %s\n", fmt_elapsed(loop_start_wide)))

# ── Performance table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

perf_wide_wb <- results_df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    outcome   = outcome_labels_wide[outcome],
    dataset   = dataset_labels[dataset],
    is_winner = paste(dataset, outcome, model) %in%
      paste(dataset_labels[winners_wide$dataset],
            outcome_labels_wide[winners_wide$outcome],
            winners_wide$winning_model),
    cell       = sprintf("%s\n%.3f / %.3f", auc_ci, sensitivity, specificity),
    cell       = if_else(is_winner, paste0(cell, " \u2020"), cell),
    brier_cell = as.character(brier)
  ) %>%
  select(dataset, outcome, model, cell, brier_cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(cell, brier_cell),
              names_glue = "{model}_{.value}")

all_cols_wb    <- names(perf_wide_wb)
model_names_wb <- unique(results_df_wide$model)
model_col_counts_wb <- sapply(model_names_wb, function(m) {
  sum(grepl(m, all_cols_wb, fixed = TRUE))
})
stopifnot(all(model_col_counts_wb == 2))
n_models_wb <- length(model_names_wb)
n_total_wb  <- 2 + sum(model_col_counts_wb)

new_names_wb <- setNames(all_cols_wb, all_cols_wb)
for (m in model_names_wb) {
  new_names_wb[paste0(m, "_cell")]       <- "AUC (95% CI)\nSens / Spec"
  new_names_wb[paste0(m, "_brier_cell")] <- "Brier"
}

ft_perf_wb <- perf_wide_wb %>%
  rename(Dataset = dataset, Outcome = outcome) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(values = as.list(new_names_wb[all_cols_wb])) %>%
  add_header_row(values    = c("", "", model_names_wb),
                 colwidths = c(1, 1, rep(2, n_models_wb))) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values    = c("", "", "Sensitivity Analysis: Wide TSH Bounds (0.1\u201310.0)"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, sum(model_col_counts_wb))) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Dataset") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "left",   j = 1:2,          part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "center", j = 3:n_total_wb,  part = "all") %>%
  bg(bg = "white", part = "all") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "header") %>%
  hline(i = 1, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
  hline(i = 3, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "body") %>%
  width(j = 1,          width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = 2,          width = 1.5) %>%
  width(j = 3:n_total_wb, width = 1.0) %>%
  add_footer_lines(
    "AUC = area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; Sens = sensitivity; Spec = specificity at the Youden-optimal threshold, locked from held-out cross-validation predictions on the training set and applied unchanged to test-set probabilities; Brier = Brier score; OOR = out of range. \u2020 Winning model (highest AUC) for that outcome \u00d7 dataset. For outcomes with event frequency below the pipeline's class-weighting threshold (5%; in this dataset, only TSH <0.1 mIU/L), all three model types were conditionally class-weighted; Brier scores for these cells reflect post-hoc Platt recalibration (fit on held-out cross-validation predictions) to correct the calibration shift introduced by weighting -- AUC and Sens/Spec are unaffected, as this is a monotonic transform."
  ) %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "footer") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "footer") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "footer")

# Rename features in a shapviz object
rename_shap_features <- function(sv_obj) {
  old_names <- colnames(sv_obj$S)
  new_names <- ifelse(old_names %in% names(feature_labels),
                      feature_labels[old_names], old_names)
  colnames(sv_obj$S) <- new_names
  colnames(sv_obj$X) <- new_names
  sv_obj
}

# ── Shared theme
theme_manuscript <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11,
                                      family = "Arial"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial",
                                      color = "gray40"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 10, family = "Arial"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12,
                                      family = "Arial")
    )
}

# BEESWARM HELPER — horizontal color bar below panel C
# Strategy: suppress legend on all panels, then manually extract and attach
# a horizontal version of the color bar below the assembled figure
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

make_beeswarm_nolabel <- function(sv_obj, outcome, mdl_name) {
  sv_importance(sv_obj,
                kind            = "beeswarm",
                max_display     = N_SHAP_FEATURES,
                color_bar_title = "Feature value") +
    labs(title    = outcome_nice[outcome],
         subtitle = mdl_name,
         x        = "SHAP value") +
    theme_manuscript() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Build horizontal color bar as a standalone grob
make_horizontal_colorbar <- function() {
  # Build a dummy continuous scale plot to extract a horizontal legend
  dummy <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 0:1, y = 0), aes(x = x, y = y, fill = x)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#440154", "#7C3B8A", "#CC6A2B", "#F5B100"),
      name   = "Feature value",
      breaks = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Low", "High")
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      title.position = "left",
      title.hjust    = 0.5,
      barwidth       = unit(6, "cm"),
      barheight      = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      ticks          = FALSE,
      direction      = "horizontal"
    )) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial",
                                      vjust = 0.8),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial")
    )
  cowplot::get_legend(dummy)
}

# Assemble 3-panel beeswarm with horizontal color bar below
assemble_beeswarm_fig <- function(panels) {
  top_3 <- wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A","B","C"))) &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12,
                                  family = "Arial"))
  colorbar <- make_horizontal_colorbar()
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    top_3, colorbar,
    ncol        = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.06)
  )
}
