# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Shared legend
legend_data <- tibble(
  model = factor(c("Elastic Net", "Random Forest", "XGBoost"),
                 levels = c("Elastic Net", "Random Forest", "XGBoost")),
  x = 0, y = 0)
dummy_legend <- ggplot(legend_data,
                       aes(x=x, y=y, color=model, linetype=model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = roc_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = roc_linetypes, name = NULL) +
  theme_manuscript() +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))
shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(dummy_legend)

make_roc_panel <- function(outcome, show_y = TRUE) {
  key <- paste("full", outcome, sep = "_")
  roc_objects <- list(
    "Elastic Net"   = roc_list[[paste0(key, "_enet")]],
    "Random Forest" = roc_list[[paste0(key, "_rf")]],
    "XGBoost"       = roc_list[[paste0(key, "_xgb")]]
  )
  winner_model <- winners %>%
    filter(dataset == "full", outcome == .env$outcome) %>%
    pull(winning_model) %>% .[1]

  # Fixed order: Elastic Net, Random Forest, XGBoost
  fixed_order <- c("Elastic Net", "Random Forest", "XGBoost")

  auc_vals <- map_dbl(fixed_order,
                      ~ as.numeric(auc(roc_objects[[.x]])))
  names(auc_vals) <- fixed_order

  auc_text <- paste(
    sprintf("%s%s: AUC\u2009=\u2009%.3f",
            fixed_order,
            ifelse(fixed_order == winner_model, "*", ""),
            auc_vals),
    collapse = "\n")

  roc_df <- purrr::map_dfr(fixed_order, function(m) {
    ro <- roc_objects[[m]]
    tibble(specificity = ro$specificities,
           sensitivity = ro$sensitivities,
           model = factor(m, levels = fixed_order))
  })

  p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity,
                           color = model, linetype = model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dotted",
                color="gray60", linewidth=0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = roc_colors[fixed_order]) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = roc_linetypes[fixed_order]) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
    annotate("text", x=0.98, y=0.05, label=auc_text,
             hjust=1, vjust=0, size=2.6, family="Arial",
             lineheight=1.3) +
    labs(title = outcome_nice[outcome],
         x     = "1 \u2212 Specificity",
         y     = if (show_y) "Sensitivity" else NULL) +
    theme_manuscript() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  if (!show_y)
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  p
}

fig2_panels <- list(
  make_roc_panel("TSH_OOR_1", show_y = TRUE),
  make_roc_panel("TSH_high",  show_y = FALSE),
  make_roc_panel("TSH_low",   show_y = FALSE)
)

make_bar_panel <- function(outcome, show_x = TRUE) {

  sv_importance(sv, kind="bar", max_display=N_SHAP_FEATURES,
                fill="#2166ac") +
    labs(title    = outcome_nice[outcome],
         subtitle = mdl_name,
         x        = if (show_x) "Mean |SHAP value|" else NULL,
         y        = NULL) +
    theme_manuscript() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = if (show_x) element_text(size=9) else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = if (show_x) element_line() else element_blank())
}

supp3_panels <- OUTCOMES %>% map(function(outcome) {
  w        <- winners %>% filter(dataset=="reduced", outcome==.env$outcome)
  mdl_name <- w$winning_model
  mdl_key  <- model_key_map[mdl_name]
  sv       <- rename_shap_features(shap_list[[paste0("reduced_",outcome,"_",mdl_key)]])
  make_beeswarm_nolabel(sv, outcome, mdl_name)
})
supp_fig3_final <- assemble_beeswarm_fig(supp3_panels)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPPLEMENTAL FIGURE 4 — Wide bounds
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

winners_wide_full <- results_df_wide %>%
  filter(dataset=="full") %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  slice_max(auc_num, n=1, with_ties=FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

supp4_panels <- OUTCOMES_WIDE %>% map(function(outcome) {
  w        <- winners_wide_full %>% filter(outcome==.env$outcome)
  mdl_name <- w$model
  mdl_key  <- model_key_map[mdl_name]
  sv       <- rename_shap_features(shap_list_wide[[paste0("wide_full_",outcome,"_",mdl_key)]])
  sv_importance(sv, kind="beeswarm", max_display=N_SHAP_FEATURES,
                color_bar_title="Feature value") +
    labs(title    = outcome_nice_wide[outcome],
         subtitle = mdl_name, x="SHAP value") +
    theme_manuscript() +
    theme(legend.position="none")
})
supp_fig4_final <- assemble_beeswarm_fig(supp4_panels)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPPLEMENTAL FIGURES 5A & 5B — Gap stratification full dataset
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

make_strat_panels <- function(stratum_name) {
  OUTCOMES %>% map(function(outcome) {
    w        <- winners_full_strat %>%
      filter(dataset==stratum_name, outcome==.env$outcome)
    mdl_name <- w$winning_model
    mdl_key  <- model_key_map[mdl_name]
    shap_key <- paste0("full_strat_",stratum_name,"_",outcome,"_",mdl_key)
    sv       <- rename_shap_features(shap_list_full_strat[[shap_key]])
    make_beeswarm_nolabel(sv, outcome, mdl_name)
  })
}

supp_fig5A_final <- assemble_beeswarm_fig(make_strat_panels("recent"))
supp_fig5B_final <- assemble_beeswarm_fig(make_strat_panels("distant"))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE ALL FIGURES
# Dimensions chosen to fit on one Word page (6.5" wide max, ~9" tall max)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

save_fig <- function(fig, path, w, h) {
  ggsave(path, fig, width=w, height=h, dpi=300, bg="white")
  cat(sprintf("\u2713 %s\n", path))
}

save_fig(fig2_final,       "./Figure_2_ROC.png",               w=9.5, h=4.2)
save_fig(fig3_final,       "./Figure_3_SHAP_bar.png",          w=5.5, h=10.5)
save_fig(fig4_final,       "./Figure_4_SHAP_beeswarm.png",     w=5.5, h=11.0)
save_fig(supp_fig3_final,  "./SuppFig3_reduced.png",           w=5.5, h=11.0)
save_fig(supp_fig4_final,  "./SuppFig4_wide.png",              w=5.5, h=11.0)
save_fig(supp_fig5A_final, "./SuppFig5A_recent.png",           w=5.5, h=11.0)
save_fig(supp_fig5B_final, "./SuppFig5B_distant.png",          w=5.5, h=11.0)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WRITE TO WORD
# Word page = 8.5" wide, 11" tall, 1" margins → content area 6.5" x 9"
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

add_fig <- function(doc, png_path, heading, w, h, style="heading 2") {
  doc %>%
    body_add_par(heading, style=style) %>%
    body_add_img(png_path, width=w, height=h) %>%
    body_add_break()
}

doc_main <- read_docx() %>%
  add_fig("./Figure_2_ROC.png",
          "Figure 2. ROC curves \u2014 Comprehensive dataset, primary outcomes",
          w=6.5, h=2.9) %>%
  add_fig("./Figure_3_SHAP_bar.png",
          "Figure 3. SHAP variable importance \u2014 Comprehensive dataset, winning models",
          w=4.5, h=8.6) %>%
  add_fig("./Figure_4_SHAP_beeswarm.png",
          "Figure 4. SHAP beeswarm \u2014 Comprehensive dataset, winning models",
          w=4.5, h=9.0)

print(doc_main, target="./Figures_2_3_4_v2.docx")
cat("\u2713 Figures_2_3_4_v2.docx written\n")

doc_supp <- read_docx() %>%
  add_fig("./SuppFig3_reduced.png",
          "Supplemental Figure 3. SHAP beeswarm \u2014 Reduced dataset, winning models",

# ── Supplemental performance tables
# Performance-table builder (shared by Supplemental Tables 3-5)
make_perf_table <- function(results_df, winners_df, title_str,
                            dataset_map, outcome_map) {
  perf_wide <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      outcome   = outcome_map[outcome],
      dataset   = dataset_map[dataset],
      is_winner = paste(dataset, outcome, model) %in%
        paste(dataset_map[winners_df$dataset],
              outcome_map[winners_df$outcome],
              winners_df$winning_model),
      cell       = sprintf("%s\n%.3f / %.3f", auc_ci, sensitivity, specificity),
      cell       = if_else(is_winner, paste0(cell, " \u2020"), cell),
      brier_cell = as.character(brier)
    ) %>%
    select(dataset, outcome, model, cell, brier_cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(cell, brier_cell),
                names_glue = "{model}_{.value}")

  all_cols    <- names(perf_wide)
  model_names <- unique(results_df$model)
  model_col_counts <- sapply(model_names, function(m) {
    sum(grepl(m, all_cols, fixed = TRUE))
  })
  n_models <- length(model_names)
  n_total  <- 2 + sum(model_col_counts)

  new_names <- setNames(all_cols, all_cols)
  for (m in model_names) {
    new_names[paste0(m, "_cell")]       <- "AUC (95% CI)\nSens / Spec"
    new_names[paste0(m, "_brier_cell")] <- "Brier"
  }

  perf_wide %>%
    rename(Dataset = dataset, Outcome = outcome) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    set_header_labels(values = as.list(new_names[all_cols])) %>%
    add_header_row(values    = c("", "", model_names),
                   colwidths = c(1, 1, rep(2, n_models))) %>%
    add_header_row(values    = c("", "", title_str),
                   colwidths = c(1, 1, sum(model_col_counts))) %>%
    merge_v(j = "Dataset") %>%
    font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
    align(align = "left",   j = 1:2,      part = "all") %>%
    align(align = "center", j = 3:n_total, part = "all") %>%
    bg(bg = "white", part = "all") %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "header") %>%
    hline(i = 1, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
    hline(i = 3, border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1.5), part = "body") %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 1.4) %>%
    width(j = 2, width = 1.4) %>%
    width(j = 3:n_total, width = 1.0) %>%
    add_footer_lines(
      "AUC = area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; Sens = sensitivity; Spec = specificity at the Youden-optimal threshold, locked from held-out cross-validation predictions on the training set and applied unchanged to test-set probabilities; Brier = Brier score. \u2020 Winning model (highest AUC) for that outcome \u00d7 dataset/stratum. For outcomes with event frequency <5%, all three model types were conditionally class-weighted; Brier scores for these cells reflect post-hoc Platt recalibration to correct the calibration shift introduced by weighting -- AUC and Sens/Spec are unaffected."
    ) %>%
    hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 0.75), part = "footer") %>%
    font(fontname = "Arial", part = "footer") %>%
    fontsize(size = 9, part = "footer")
}

# Requires in session: results_df, winners (primary)
#                      results_df_wide, winners_wide (wide bounds)
#                      results_df_full_strat, winners_full_strat (full strat)

# Supp Table 3: reduced dataset
ft_supp3 <- make_perf_table(
  results_df %>% filter(dataset == "reduced"),
  winners %>% filter(dataset == "reduced"),
  title_str   = "Sensitivity Analysis: Reduced Dataset",
  dataset_map = dataset_labels,
  outcome_map = outcome_labels
)

# Supp Table 4: wide bounds
ft_supp4 <- make_perf_table(
  results_df_wide,
  winners_wide,
  title_str   = "Sensitivity Analysis: Wide TSH Bounds (0.1\u201310.0)",
  dataset_map = dataset_labels,
  outcome_map = outcome_labels_wide
)

# Supp Table 5: full dataset gap stratification
ft_supp5 <- make_perf_table(
  results_df_full_strat,
  winners_full_strat,
  title_str   = "Sensitivity Analysis: Follow-up Interval Stratification (Comprehensive Dataset)",
  dataset_map = stratum_labels_full,
  outcome_map = outcome_labels
)

# ── Supplemental Tables document (separate from figures)
doc_supp_tables <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Supplemental Table 3. Model performance \u2014 Reduced dataset",
               style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_supp3) %>%
  body_add_break() %>%
  body_add_par("Supplemental Table 4. Model performance \u2014 Wide TSH bounds (0.1\u201310.0)",
               style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_supp4) %>%
  body_add_break() %>%
  body_add_par("Supplemental Table 5. Model performance \u2014 Follow-up interval stratification (comprehensive dataset)",
               style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_supp5)

print(doc_supp_tables, target = "./Supplemental_Tables_3_4_5.docx")
cat("\u2713 Supplemental_Tables_3_4_5.docx written\n")
